passive.name: Unseen Predator
passive.description: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack. Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered. Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

spells.name: Savagery
spells.description: Rengar's next 2 Attacks gain % Attack Speed. The first Attack deals physical damage. Max Ferocity: The first Attack deals physical damage and grants Rengar Attack Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation QTotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Battle Roar
spells.description: Rengar roars, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and restoring % of the damage taken in the last seconds as Health. Max Ferocity: Deals magic damage and additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Bola Strike
spells.description: Rengar throws a bola, dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by % for seconds. Max Ferocity: Deals physical damage and Roots for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Thrill of the Hunt
spells.description: Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged. Active: Rengar gains % Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for seconds. After seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional physical damage, shreds Armor for seconds, and ends this Ability.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BonusDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
